text:
maria: heads up — hosted API p99 spiked around 21:34 UTC, p99 -> ~1.8s, p95 mostly steady (~420ms). grafana: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/serve/hosted-p99?orgId=1 :thinking_face:

deploy-bot: deployed batch-sampler v2 to prod (canary->all) at 1716123400 by ci/cd-pipeline :rocket:

jon: saw it. running lightweight perf profile on the runtime nodes that serve the hosted pool now.

maria: queue depth heatmap shows backlog on shard g4-6, backlog peaked ~320 requests in queue. latency tail matches backlog timing. p50/p95 almost unchanged.

ali: kernel_fallback_count spiked at the same time. logs show repeated kernel_mismatch=true + fallback_to_generic. snippet: `kernel_id=fast_attention_v2 fallback=1 reason=batch_size=3->1`

rob: KV cache metrics look bad around spike window — eviction_rate jumped x8, kv_hit dropped 94%->48%. suspect thrash from rapid prefix churn.

emily: any noisy tenant? I see tenant-192 with sustained high RPS at the time (x3 baseline). could be hammering small, high-concurrency requests. @maria can we throttle tenant-192 temporarily?

sasha: I can run a batch-size distribution probe to confirm. also let's consider reverting batch-sampler v2 which changed sampling policy for small-prefetch prefixes. quick rollback would validate causality.

jon: attaching brief flame snippet from perf: ```
# flame summary (hot stacks)
memcpy  28%\nspin_lock 14%\nkernel_dispatch_generic 22%\nattention_kern_v2 9%\nbatching_coordinator 11%\n```
small batch counts increased 4x after sampler change -> more kernel dispatches hitting generic path and higher memcpy overhead per-request.

ali: mitigation proposal: 1) force 'preferred_kernel=large_batch' affinity for affected model family, 2) increase batch_timeout_ms from 6 -> 14 for hosted pool, 3) add short-term tenant rate cap on tenant-192. commands to test: `rdwctl runtime set-affinity --kernel large_batch --model v1.3 --pool hosted`

maria: rolling back batch-sampler v2 now (rollback triggered at 1716123495). will watch p99 and queue depth.

deploy-bot: rollback batch-sampler v2 completed at 1716123499 :white_check_mark:

emily: p99 trending down to ~520ms after rollback, queue depth falling. kv_hit recovering slowly (now ~70%). still watching for 15m. :eyes:

rob: can we add an alert: kernel_fallback_rate > 0.5% for >5m and tenant_kv_eviction_rate spike? also add tenant noisy-signal to routing to avoid mixing with small-request latency-sensitive workloads.

sasha: filed perf follow-up INF-1421 with profiler captures, flamegraphs, and batch-distribution traces. will include reproducer for local testing.

maria: thanks all — stabilizing. leaving this thread for the postmortem notes. closing once graphs are green. :slightly_smiling_face:
